interpretation_hint: One line of the call's agenda: a high-level part of the call such as 'Check in' or 'Pricing'. A one-hour call has 4 to 8. When someone states the agenda, in speech or in a chat message, create one AgendaItem per line, in the words used. When no agenda was stated and the conversation moves to a subject that none of the `existing` AgendaItems covers, create one for it; name it for the whole part of the call, not for the first point made in it. Never create a second AgendaItem for a part that is already in `existing`. Keep `status` up to date: when the turns show the call moving on to another part, emit the AgendaItem that starts with status `current` and the one that ended with status `done`, each with its `id`.

properties.name: title
properties.interpretation_hint: The agenda line as stated, or 2-6 words naming this part of the call.

properties.name: order
properties.interpretation_hint: Position on the agenda as a number: 1 for the first line, 2 for the second.

properties.name: source
properties.interpretation_hint: `stated` when someone gave this line as agenda, `detected` when you created it from the flow of the conversation.

properties.name: status
properties.interpretation_hint: Where the call is: `upcoming` before this part starts, `current` while the call is in it, `done` once the call has moved on. Two parts can be `current` together when the talk goes back and forth between them.
